status: MEASURED for codex and opencode (5 trials each); other CLIs not yet run
method: Identical task ('create hello.txt containing exactly: hi'), same machine, artifact-verified (file must exist AND contain exactly 'hi'), invoked through providers/codex.sh provider_invoke_argv -- the Loki provider layer, not a raw CLI call. 5 trials, 300s cap.

codex.auth: ChatGPT free tier, no API key
codex.note: The single timeout is reported, not discarded. Dropping it would turn a 4/5 success rate into an implied 5/5 and overstate reliability.

why_5_trials: A single sample is not a measurement here. An earlier one-shot run timed out and would have been published as 'codex: timeout' -- a fabricated competitive claim, since the same command completed in 51s minutes later. The spread (48s to a 300s timeout) is the actual finding.
bug_found_by_measuring: provider_invoke_argv passed provider_get_tier_param to --model, but for Codex that returns an EFFORT level (high/xhigh/low), not a model name. Every argv invocation sent '--model high' and got a 400. Fixed; effort now travels in CODEX_MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT. Guarded by tests/test-codex-argv-model.sh.
not_claimed: No overall ranking between tools. aider, Claude Code and cursor-agent have NOT been run on this task. Devin and Replit Agent ship no local CLI. Cost is not compared: codex ran on a free tier and opencode's per-call cost was not recorded.

opencode.invoked_via: opencode run <message> (direct CLI; Loki drives it via providers/opencode.sh)
opencode.note: First trial 265s, then 7/12/11/4s. The first-run cost is real and worth reporting: a new user experiences the 265s, not the median.

comparison.task: create hello.txt containing exactly 'hi'; artifact verified by content
comparison.reading: On this ONE trivial task, opencode was faster at the median and completed 5/5; codex was slower and timed out once. Both show a large first-run penalty, which a median alone hides.
comparison.do_not_overread: One trivial file-creation task is NOT a proxy for build quality, multi-iteration work, or brownfield capability. It measures headless invocation latency and nothing more.
